```json
 "topology": "Two-stage Miller (NMOS-input 5T first stage, PMOS CS second stage, Rz-Cc compensation)",
 "rationale": "Budget is 11.1 uA: Iref 1 uA, tail 2.2 uA, stage-2 6.5 uA, about 17.5 uW. Long-L devices give about 39+34 dB of gain. GBW is gm1/Cc, with 2 pF and gm1 about 16 uS, giving 1.3 MHz. PM 60 needs gm7 above about 2.2*2pi*GBW*CL, which is about 90 uS from weak-inversion PMOS at gm/Id about 15. Rz of about 2.5/gm7 adds an LHP zero near p2. An NMOS input suits VCM = 0.9 V."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # input pair L
    "Itail": (2.2e-6, 1.2e-6, 3.5e-6),
    "gmidl": (11.0, 7.0, 14.0),      # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "Ll":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmid7": (15.0, 10.0, 16.0),     # 2nd stage PMOS gm/Id
    "L7":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "I7":    (6.5e-6, 4e-6, 8e-6),
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS current-source L
    "Cc":    (2.0e-12, 1.0e-12, 4e-12),
    "kz":    (2.5, 1.0, 5.0),        # Rz = kz/gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 1e-6)
    It, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    gmidn = 9.0

    # NMOS bias mirrors (all from ibias diode)
    mref = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], It, vds=0.35)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)
    # input pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.5, vsb=0.35)
    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidl"], p["Ll"], It / 2, vds=0.9)
    # second stage
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], I7, vds=0.9)
    Rz = p["kz"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    # vinp -> M1 drives the diode side; vinn -> M2 drives the output node n1.
    # Signal path: vinp up -> n1 up -> vout down (inverting PMOS CS), and vinn up -> n1 down -> vout up.
    # That polarity is wrong, so vinp goes to the n1 side and vinn goes to the diode side.
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "n1", "nz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "nz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    C2 = cl + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    p2 = m7.gm * Cc / (C1 * C2 + Cc * (C1 + C2)) / (2 * PI)
    dz = Rz - 1.0 / m7.gm
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * dz) if dz > 0 else -1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * abs(dz) + 1e-30)
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    pm_mirror = m3.gm / (2 * m3.cgg) / (2 * PI)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pm_mirror)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z))
    power = 1.8 * (iref + It + I7)
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power, "slew": slew}
```
